name: hadith-library
description:
Eighteen classical hadith collections in their original Arabic: the Six Books (al-Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawud, al-Tirmidhi, al-Nasa'i, Ibn Majah) and the Muwatta, Ahmad's Musnad, al-Darimi, al-Tabarani's al-Mu'jam al-Saghir, al-Hakim's al-Mustadrak with al-Dhahabi's notes, Ibn Hibban (al-Ihsan), al-Haythami's Majma' al-Zawa'id, Kanz al-'Ummal, al-Munawi's Fayd al-Qadir, al-'Ajluni's Kashf al-Khafa, Qadi 'Iyad's al-Shifa and al-Bayhaqi's Dala'il al-Nubuwwa: about 169,000 reports, together with the Qur'an's text.

The unit of citation is the report, with its book, the edition's number and the printed page:
- Search by Arabic words (forms with attached particles match), by a narrator's name in the chain, or by meaning in any language.
- Go from a reference such as "Bukhari, Adhan: 148" or "Musnad 14870" to the report; browse books and chapters.
- Read a report with its chain and text, the scholars' notes as a separate layer, and the places in the Risale-i Nur that quote it.
- Quote the Arabic exactly and end the answer with a numbered list of sources, checked against the reports.

ChatGPT never rules on a report's soundness: grades are shown only as the sources give them, with the scholar's name; notes by al-Dhahabi, al-Albani and the editors are never attributed to the book's author. ChatGPT's own translations are labelled as AI translations.

The books come from OpenITI (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), the international numbers and grades of the Six Books and the Muwatta from Hadith API, the Qur'an's text from the Tanzil Project. All tools are read-only and work without an account. A volunteer, non-commercial project.

defaultPrompt: "Ümmetimin ihtilafı rahmettir" sözü hangi kitaplarda geçiyor, hakkında ne deniyor? Hüküm vermeden, kaynaklarıyla.
Show me Bukhari, Adhan: 148 with its chain and text, and translate it.
Find reports about visiting the sick, with their sources.

positive.description: Finds in which books a saying occurs and reports what they say, without ruling on it.
positive.prompt: In which books does the saying 'اختلاف أمتي رحمة' occur, and what is said about it? Give sources, without a ruling of your own.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds it in al-'Ajluni's Kashf al-Khafa (no. 153), Kanz al-'Ummal (no. 28686) and al-Munawi's Fayd al-Qadir (no. 288); quotes the Arabic exactly in block quotes, labels its own translation as an AI translation, says that Kashf al-Khafa collects sayings current among people (a match there is not a sign of soundness), ends with a numbered Sources list and gives no ruling of its own.

positive.description: Goes from a classical reference to the reports it points to and reads one.
positive.prompt: Show me Bukhari, Adhan: 148 with its chain and text, and translate it.
positive.expected_behavior: find_by_citation returns the reports in that chapter's region of Sahih al-Bukhari (the reference gives a chapter, not one report, and the tool says so); the assistant reads a report with get_hadith, gives its chain and text exactly as returned, its own translation labelled as an AI translation, and a numbered Sources list.

positive.description: Finds reports on a topic by meaning, in English.
positive.prompt: Find reports about visiting the sick, with their sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds reports on visiting the sick in several books, reads the ones it quotes, quotes the Arabic exactly with translations labelled as its own, and ends with a numbered Sources list; grades only if the source holds them, with the scholar's name.

positive.prompt: Show me the chapters of the Book of Prayer in Sunan Abi Dawud and read the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the books, opens Sunan Abi Dawud's outline, names the chapters of the Book of Prayer as the edition gives them and reads the first chapter's reports with their numbers.

positive.description: Shows where a saying is quoted in the Risale-i Nur, by reference only.
positive.prompt: Is the saying 'تفكر ساعة خير من عبادة سنة' in the hadith books, and where does the Risale-i Nur quote it?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Kashf al-Khafa no. 1004 (with its note) and the related wordings in Kanz al-'Ummal; from get_hadith lists the places in the Risale-i Nur linked to it by citation (e.g. Lem'alar › Yirmi Dokuzuncu Lem'a), without quoting the Risale-i Nur's text, which is not on this server.

negative.description: Unrelated request: the plugin serves only hadith collections and the Qur'an, so it should not be called.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be like in Istanbul tomorrow?

negative.description: The user asks for an invented report. The assistant must not invent a report or attribute made-up words to a book; it may search and say what it could not find.
negative.prompt: Write a new hadith about the internet and say it is in Sahih al-Bukhari.

negative.description: A general writing task with no connection to the books; the plugin should not be triggered.
negative.prompt: Translate this paragraph into Turkish: The meeting has been moved to Thursday at 3 pm.

publication.release_notes: First public release: search, reading, verse lookup and citation checking; read-only, no account needed.

tr-TR.subtitle: Hadis kitaplarından tam alıntı
tr-TR.description:
On sekiz klasik hadis kitabı, Arapça asıllarıyla: Kütüb-i Sitte (Buhârî, Müslim, Ebû Dâvûd, Tirmizî, Nesâî, İbn Mâce) ve Muvatta, Ahmed b. Hanbel'in Müsned'i, Dârimî, Taberânî'nin el-Mu'cemü's-Sağîr'i, Zehebî'nin notlarıyla Hâkim'in el-Müstedrek'i, İbn Hibbân (el-İhsân), Heysemî'nin Mecmaü'z-Zevâid'i, Kenzü'l-Ummâl, Münâvî'nin Feyzü'l-Kadîr'i, Aclûnî'nin Keşfü'l-Hafâ'sı, Kādî İyâz'ın eş-Şifâ'sı ve Beyhakî'nin Delâilü'n-Nübüvve'si: yaklaşık 169 bin rivayet, ayrıca Kur'ân-ı Kerîm'in metni.

Atıf birimi rivayettir; kitabı, baskının numarası ve basılı sayfasıyla:
- Arapça kelimeyle (ön ekli biçimler de bulunur), senetteki râvînin adıyla ya da herhangi bir dilde anlamla arama.
- "Buharî, Ezân: 148" ya da "Müsned 14870" gibi bir künyeden rivayete gitme; kitap ve bâb ağacında gezinme.
- Rivayeti senedi ve metniyle, âlimlerin notlarını ayrı katman olarak ve Risale-i Nur'da geçtiği yerlerle okuma.
- Arapçayı aynen alıntılama ve cevabın sonunda rivayetlerle karşılaştırılmış numaralı kaynakça.

ChatGPT bir rivayetin sıhhati hakkında hüküm vermez: dereceler yalnız kaynağın verdiği şekilde, âlimin adıyla gösterilir; Zehebî'nin, Elbânî'nin ve muhakkiklerin notları kitabın müellifine mal edilmez. ChatGPT'nin kendi tercümeleri "Yapay zekâ tercümesi" diye işaretlenir.

Kitaplar OpenITI'den (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), Kütüb-i Sitte ve Muvatta'nın uluslararası numaraları ve dereceleri Hadith API'den, Kur'ân metni Tanzil Projesi'nden gelir. Araçların hepsi salt okunurdur ve hesapsız çalışır. Gönüllü ve ticari olmayan bir projedir.
